notes.title: Achievement FIX
notes.content:
Fixed performance issues associated with Steam API implementation.
 All achievements can now be earned
 Chaos Master, Destroyer and Oneiric Walker are now easier to achieve
 Fixed a bug that prevented to see Dr. Zuengo talking just when entering the room


Thanks for continuing to help us improve the game!

notes.title: PATCH 1
notes.content:
Hello, friends of dreams and mysteries!

Patch 1 of The Murder of Sherlock Holmes is ready, which includes some improvements that many of you have asked for :D

New features:

 Added option in the console to activate FullMotion.
 Now you can select full control with the right joystick.
 Camera mode can now be toggled (snap or full).

Improvements:

 Improved console buttons so that they can't be pressed at the same time.
 Improved room textures.


Keep reporting to us anything you want to change in the game so we can continue to improve it for you. Without you, it wouldn't be worth the effort to update The Murder of Sherlock Holmes.

Thanks for playing!

See you soon!

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
The final door is no longer a problem.
 The screen does not darken when you bring something close to your face.
 Left joystick control improved.


This is just a fast hotfix, we will have a new patch very soon with everything you are asking for ːsteamhappyː.

Thank you so much for helping us improve the game!
